description: This file contains utility functions for processing Markdown content, including stripping Markdown syntax, converting Markdown to HTML, and rendering Markdown nodes with custom renderers. It is part of the Mattermost project and handles Markdown parsing and rendering logic.

classes.name: notificationRenderer
classes.description: Custom renderer for Markdown nodes used in HTML conversion.

methods.name: newNotificationRenderer
methods.description: Creates a new instance of notificationRenderer.

methods.name: RegisterFuncs
methods.description: Registers rendering functions for different Markdown node types.

methods.name: renderDefault
methods.description: Default renderer that performs no changes.

methods.name: renderItem
methods.description: Renders list items and headings with spacing.

methods.name: renderText
methods.description: Renders text nodes, handling line breaks.

methods.name: writeLines
methods.description: Writes lines of a code block or similar node.
